notes: Director's cut for U1-E9 'Cram Session' (script v3, Maya+Marcus). 15 scenes. Each scene carries a 'turns' [start, end] partition of the 55 TTS turn files (t00..t54, including the two 5-second silence segments at t44 and t47) — run refit_durations.py against the rendered turns dir to replace the estimated duration_sec values with measured sums (the mix is a straight concat, so this is exact). Visual grammar: KeywordPops and captions restate spoken terms only; textured or dimmed-photo backgrounds, never blank; one scene per question or question-pair; stepsslide recap; quoteslide close. Eyes-closed-safe: narration never references the visuals.
